correctness.rationale: From all 72 assigned tetrahedra the independently programmed reconstruction gives exactly f=(14,86,144,72), 86 edges, 308 graph triangles and 144 facial triangles. Contracting a different spanning tree gives Z^73 and integral 144x73 facial relation matrix; an exact integral Hermite normal form calculation yields finite quotient order 5, while independent F5 reduction has rank 72. Every one of 164 nonfacial triangles evaluates in F5^* under a nonzero kernel cocycle, with oriented counts 41,44,38,41 and inverse-pair multiplicities 82/82. Exhaustive graph-degree/facet signature cell-preserving automorphisms give group order 4 with induced homology multipliers 1,2,3,4 and carrier orbit sizes 39x4 plus 4x2. These exact finite checks reconstruct the proof for this single explicitly given triangulation. The graph-cycle and minimal-simple-cycle conclusions follow from definitions; no unbounded claim is inferred.
residual_risks: Finite proof applies only to the assigned facet presentation, not every L(5,2) triangulation.
The source facet list is the shared input to independent computations; its identification with L(5,2) is corroborated by the primary Lutz data, not derived from first principles.

value.rationale: The natural smallest-known 14-vertex triangulation of L(5,2) has H1=Z/5 with two distinct unoriented generator classes. The exact 164-carrier classification of the minimal simple-cycle layer, unexpected 82/82 balance, and full C4 realization of all units together form a complete motivated finite homological/symmetry invariant of a standard small lens-space complex; they do not mechanically follow from ambient homology or face vector. Such exact shortest-loop and symmetry data are independently useful for combinatorial topology comparisons even without a generalization to other triangulations.
residual_risks: Motivation is finite/exact rather than a theorem for every lens-space triangulation; interpretation must not promise metric systolic consequences.
